title: The same radical history can produce different conversion
statement: For the same R=2/s,r=1/s,one-second pulse,gamma=3, fresh q=1 gives X=.6017034531 while depleted q=0 gives .9502129316. R(t) alone does not determine an unknown q. This is an initial-state ambiguity in the declared model, not every acoustic sensor. Independently bounded history, chemical-state or final adhesion/porosity/flow/mechanical observations could distinguish it; none is installed here.
